summary: @servicetitan/feature-spotlight preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares itself as CSS styling utilities for React components, but its package.json defines a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is a hex-identifier-obfuscated script that downloads the Bun runtime zip from GitHub releases (github.com/oven-sh/bun), extracts the Bun binary to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it with `execFileSync(bunPath, [<tarball>/math_init.js])`. math_init.js is a ~727KB Bun-compiled bundle with a shuffled string-array and hex-mangled identifiers, unrelated to the package's declared CSS purpose. The tarball's `files` field declares only `['dist','src']`, yet setup.mjs and math_init.js are shipped at the tarball root — placed outside the declared publish surface but wired into the install lifecycle. Running `npm install` on this package causes the obfuscated payload to execute automatically on the installer's machine under an alternate runtime that bypasses Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
